description: Hand-written labelled pairs for effect-key CAID evaluation. Every payload and label was written by hand for this prototype; it is NOT field data and says nothing about real traffic rates.
provenance: hand-written edits over four base payloads (scratch builder kept with the agent session)

label_definitions.same_effect: both calls should produce one business effect (a retry/regeneration of the same intent)
label_definitions.different_effect: both calls are intended, distinct effects; merging them would refuse a wanted effect

pairs.label: same_effect
pairs.note: fresh client request UUID after restore

pairs.label: same_effect
pairs.note: object member order only; JCS sorts keys, so the full-payload CAID also matches

pairs.label: same_effect
pairs.note: creditor display name differs; not an identity field

pairs.label: same_effect
pairs.note: memo + UUID + timestamp + list order all regenerated (benchmark F8 shape)

pairs.label: same_effect
pairs.note: regenerated call adds an optional purpose code

pairs.label: same_effect
pairs.note: HARD CASE: the agent also regenerated the business reference; effect key cannot merge this

pairs.label: same_effect
pairs.note: HARD CASE: agent emitted major units as a float; normalizer refuses (fail closed)

pairs.label: same_effect
pairs.note: HARD CASE: regenerated call dropped the business reference; refused (missing identity field)

pairs.label: different_effect
pairs.note: different creditor account, same display name

pairs.label: different_effect
pairs.note: next invoice, same amount and creditor

pairs.label: different_effect
pairs.note: two intended identical payments; only the business reference differs

pairs.label: different_effect
pairs.note: split payment, two identical halves with distinct refs

pairs.label: different_effect
pairs.note: every incidental field identical, amount edited

pairs.label: different_effect
pairs.note: same payment debited from a different account

pairs.label: different_effect
pairs.note: one digit changed; mod-97 fails, so the effect key refuses (fail closed)

pairs.label: different_effect
pairs.note: two identical salary lines to one account (e.g. two contracts), distinct refs
